VEN-001.name: Baccai Sandspinner
VEN-001.rulesText:
[Empower] [5]. This ability costs [3] less if you control 4 or fewer runes.

VEN-002.name: Blade Twirler
VEN-002.rulesText: The first time I move each turn, choose a player. They [Burn 1].

VEN-003.name: Brittle Steel
VEN-003.flavorText: Cold is older than stone, older than steel. And when these are gone, the cold will remain.

VEN-004.name: Dune Surfer
VEN-004.rulesText: You ignore [Tank] while assigning combat damage here.
VEN-004.flavorText: "Look at this rug! How can one child track this much sand?!"

VEN-006.name: Oasis Raider
VEN-006.rulesText: If you control fewer runes than an opponent at the start of your Beginning Phase, give me +2[M] and [Ganking] this turn.
VEN-006.flavorText: "A simple mistake! It's actually more closely related to a gharial—AUGH!" —Surprisingly common last words

VEN-008.name: Ruthless Strike
VEN-008.rulesText:
[Action]
As an additional cost to play this, you may discard 1.
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If you paid the additional cost, deal 5 to it instead.
VEN-008.flavorText: If you choose to destroy, hold nothing back.

VEN-009.name: Baccai Reaper
VEN-009.rulesText: When I attack, you may pay [R] to give me [Assault 2] this turn.
VEN-009.flavorText: The Ascended god-warriors of Shurima pity their lesser cousins.

VEN-010.name: Consuming Curse

[Action]
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield. This deals 1 Bonus Damage for each card with this name in your trash.

VEN-011.name: Pendulum Blade
VEN-011.effectText: When I move to a battlefield, give me +2[M] this turn. [M]+1

VEN-012.name: Perfect Execution

Ready a unit and give it [Assault 3] this turn.
[Flow] [3][R]

VEN-013.name: Shadow Assassin
VEN-013.rulesText: I enter ready if you have a card with my name in your trash.
VEN-013.flavorText: When the sun rises, all memories of her will fade.

VEN-014.name: Shadow Fiend
VEN-014.flavorText: It justifies every fear of the dark.

VEN-015.name: Decree of Rage
VEN-015.rulesText:
[Action]
This can't be countered.
Deal 4 to an enemy Calm unit.

VEN-016.name: Eclipse Dragon
VEN-016.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I move, if you control 4 or fewer runes, draw 1.
VEN-016.flavorText: Power enough to command the sun to wait.

VEN-017.name: Morgana, Vindictive
VEN-017.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When you play me, deal damage to a unit equal to the damage marked on it.
VEN-017.flavorText: "Some call me evil. Shall I prove them right?"

VEN-018.name: Rage Amplifier
VEN-018.rulesText:
[Empower] [6][R]
Your units have +1[M]. If I'm [Empowered], they have +2[M] instead.
VEN-018.flavorText: Irritation and incitement are a decibel apart.

VEN-019.name: Renekton, Rage Fueled
VEN-019.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I attack, if you control 4 or fewer runes, deal 2 to all enemy units here.

VEN-020.name: Twilight Reveler
VEN-020.rulesText: When I attack, ready another friendly unit.
VEN-020.flavorText: There's always time for one last dance.

VEN-021.name: Akali, Deadly Weapon
VEN-021.rulesText:
[Empower] [2][R]
When I move, you may deal 1 to a unit at a battlefield I moved to or from. If I'm [Empowered], deal 2 instead.
[Empowered][>] I have +1[M].

VEN-022.rulesText:
When you play this, banish your hand and trash, then [Burn 7].
Skip your Draw Phase.
You may play cards from your trash.
If a card would go to your trash from anywhere other than your Main Deck, banish it instead.

VEN-023.name: Zed, From the Shadows
VEN-023.rulesText:
You may discard 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, play a 0[M] Shadow Clone unit token.

VEN-024.name: Affectionate Poro
VEN-024.rulesText: When a combat that I was in ends, if I haven't been dealt damage this turn, draw 1.

VEN-026.name: Field Musicians
VEN-026.rulesText: When you play me, give a unit +3[M] this turn.

VEN-027.name: Hand Hammer
VEN-027.effectText: I have +2[M] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control. [M]+1

VEN-028.name: Mournful Witness
VEN-028.rulesText:
When a combat that I was in ends, empower me.
[Empowered][>] I have +2[M].
VEN-028.flavorText: Nature's way is to remember, but not to resent.

VEN-029.name: Ol' Poro
VEN-029.rulesText: I can't be played on your first, second, or third turns.
VEN-029.flavorText: They have long awaited the ol' poro's wisdom. Any day now...

VEN-031.name: Twilight Shroud
VEN-031.rulesText:
Give a friendly unit +1[M] this turn. It can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities this turn.
[Flow] [2].

VEN-032.name: Frostcoat Mother
VEN-032.rulesText:
[Empower] [12]. This ability costs [1] less for each rune you control.
[Empowered][>] I have +3[M].
VEN-032.flavorText:
Few step between a mother and her pack.
None do it twice.

VEN-033.name: Pakaa Protector
VEN-033.rulesText: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's a unit, draw it. Otherwise, put it in your trash and give me +2[M] this turn.
VEN-033.flavorText:
"There's no such thing as a pakaa cub on its own."
—Wilderness survival tip

VEN-034.name: Resonating Strike
VEN-034.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Reaction]
Choose a battlefield you control and a unit you control at a different location. Move that unit to that battlefield and give it +2[M] this turn.

VEN-035.name: Sanction
VEN-035.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose one —
• Empower a unit. Disempower it at end of turn.
• Disempower a unit that's [Empowered]. Empower it at end of turn.

VEN-036.name: Sandstone Chimera
VEN-036.rulesText: While I'm at a battlefield, players only channel 1 rune at the start of their Channel Phase.
VEN-036.flavorText: Past timeless winds and storms, she wills the tides of sand to still.

VEN-037.name: Tomb-Raider Barbara
VEN-037.rulesText: When you play me, if you control 7 or more runes, choose an enemy gear. If it's [Empowered], disempower it. Otherwise, kill it.
VEN-037.flavorText: Wait for her signal. Don't worry, you'll know.

VEN-038.name: Akali, Silent
VEN-038.rulesText:
I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat.
When I move to a battlefield, give me +2[M] this turn.
VEN-038.flavorText: "Skill and steel will get the job done."

VEN-039.name: Crumbling Sands
VEN-039.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Counter a spell if an opponent has played another spell this turn.
VEN-039.flavorText: Time will reduce all greed to gust.

VEN-040.name: Decree of Focus
VEN-040.rulesText: Choose a friendly unit that's in combat with an enemy Fury unit or that's being chosen by an enemy Fury spell. Give it +4[M] this turn.
VEN-040.flavorText: Rage is a quagmire. Tread lightly.

VEN-041.name: Riven, Shattered
VEN-041.rulesText:
[Weaponmaster]
When I attack, choose an enemy unit here. Deal 2 to it for each Equipment attached to me.

VEN-042.name: Shen, Scourge of Shadows
VEN-042.rulesText: When I hold, if there is exactly one other unit you control here, draw 1.

VEN-043.name: Steel Paws
VEN-043.flavorText: When the rats get too big, it's time to innovate.

VEN-044.name: Astral Heron
VEN-044.rulesText: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card you play this turn costs [2][A][A] less.
VEN-044.flavorText: With its flight, the night falls.

VEN-045.name: Helm of Suppression
VEN-045.rulesText:
[Empower] [4][G]
Opponents' spells cost [1] more. If this is [Empowered], they cost [1][A] more instead.

VEN-046.name: Nasus, Ascended
VEN-046.rulesText:
[Deflect 2]
[Empower] [8]
[Empowered][>] When I conquer, you score 1 point.

VEN-048.name: Cloud Drake
VEN-048.flavorText: These things are a cirrus problem.

VEN-050.name: Grumpy Rockbear
VEN-050.rulesText:
[Empower] [12]. This ability costs [1] less for each rune you control.
[Empowered][>] I have [Deflect] and [Shield 3].

VEN-051.name: Iterative Design
VEN-051.flavorText: It's not always a bad thing to reinvent the wheel.

VEN-052.name: Mesmerize
VEN-052.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose one —
• Return a friendly unit to its owner's hand.
• Give an enemy unit -2[M] this turn.

VEN-055.name: Applied Researchers
VEN-055.rulesText:
[Empower] [3]
[Empowered][>] Your spells cost [1][A] less, to a minimum of [1].
VEN-055.flavorText: "Prognostication Test 11: Successful, but Tests 149 and 19 will fail. What happens if we skip them?"

VEN-057.name: Covert Informant
VEN-057.flavorText: When one person knows, it's a secret. When two know, it's a deal.

VEN-058.name: Patched Porobot

VEN-058.flavorText: Attempts to synthetically replicate a poro's whimsy and pure adorable nature have yielded mixed results.

VEN-059.name: Shock Blast
VEN-059.rulesText:
[Action]
This costs [2] less if you control something that's [Empowered].
Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.

VEN-060.name: Sky Cruiser
VEN-060.rulesText: Discard a gear, [1], [E]: Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.

VEN-061.name: Decree of Insight
VEN-061.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Ignore [Deflect] while paying this spell's cost.

VEN-062.name: Hextech Formula
VEN-062.rulesText:
This enters exhausted.
[E]: Empower another gear.

I cost [1] less for each gear your control.

VEN-065.name: Swain, Visionary
VEN-065.rulesText:
[Vision]

VEN-066.name: Temporal Breach

[Hidden]

VEN-069.name: Mel, Newly Awakened
VEN-069.rulesText:
When you play me, draw 1.
[Empower] [3]
[Empowered][>] Your spells and abilities can't be countered. If a spell or ability you control would give -[M] to a unit it chooses, it gives an additional -1[M].

VEN-071.name: Fretful Feline

VEN-072.name: Guttural Roar

[Action]
Give a unit +2[M] this turn. If it's [Empowered], give it +4[M] this turn instead.

VEN-073.name: Jagged Cutlass
VEN-073.effectText: I can't be moved by enemy spells and abilities. [M]+2

VEN-075.name: Platewyrm Egg
VEN-075.rulesText:
This enters exhausted.
[Empower] — [1], [E]
[Reaction][>] [E]: [Add] [1]. If this is [Empowered], [Add] [2] instead.

VEN-076.name: Repair Specialist
VEN-076.rulesText: I have [Assault] equal to the number of gear you control.

VEN-077.name: Tools of Empire

[Empower] [2]
[E]: Give a unit +2[M] this turn. If this is [Empowered], give that unit +4[M] this turn instead.

"We will unearth what has been lost."
—Azir

[Empower] [5][O]

[Empower] [3][O]
[Empowered][>] I have +3[M] and can't be dealt damage unless I'm in combat.

[Empower] — [E]

VEN-088.rulesText:
When I become ready, choose one to give me this turn —
• [Assault 2]
• [Deflect 2]
• [Ganking]

VEN-091.name: Corrupted Dragon
VEN-091.rulesText:
If your score is not within 3 points of the Victory Score, I enter read.

VEN-092.rulesText:
[1]: Give me +1[M] this turn.
When my Might becomes 10 or more, empower me.
[Empowered][>] I havve [Deflect] and [Ganking].

VEN-093.name: Kinkou Lifeblade
VEN-093.flavorText: His life is the blade. His blade is his life.

VEN-094.name: Mask Mother

VEN-095.name: Shadow Order Disciple
VEN-095.rulesText: When I move, you may [Burn 1] to give me +1[M] this turn.

VEN-096.name: Shadowcloaked Lurker
VEN-096.rulesText: I cost [2] less for each card with my name in your trash.
VEN-096.flavorText: You'll never see the second one coming.

VEN-097.name: Spiderling
VEN-097.rulesText:
[Hidden]
I have +1[M] for each other unit you control here with my name.
Your deck can have any number of cards named Spiderling.
VEN-097.flavorText: Well, at least there's only one.

VEN-098.name: Stargazer
VEN-098.rulesText: Spells with [Flow] you play from your trash cost [2] less, to a minimum of [1].

VEN-099.name: Tornado Warrior
VEN-099.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me from face down, you may empower something here. Disempower it at end of turn.

VEN-100.name: Up from the Deep
VEN-100.rulesText:
Play two 1[M] Tentacle unit tokens from Bilgewater.
[Flow] [3]
VEN-100.flavorText:
"The waves will drag you down, unless you fight to shore."
—Illaoi

VEN-101.name: Gust Monk
VEN-101.rulesText:
You may pay [1] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, banish a card from any trash to give a unit [Assault 2] this turn.
VEN-101.flavorText: An odd technique, but quite effective.

VEN-102.name: Ravenbloom Prefect
VEN-102.rulesText: When an opponent plays a gear, you may banish me to banish it.
VEN-102.flavorText: "Do you have a permit for that?"

VEN-103.name: Shadows of the Past
VEN-103.rulesText: Return up to 2 units from trashes to their owners' hands.

VEN-104.name: Tail-Cloaked Matriarch
VEN-104.rulesText:
[Empower] [2][P]
When I become [Empowered], you may choose a unit in your trash with Energy cost not more than [3] and Power cost no more than [A]. Play it to your base, ignoring its cost.

VEN-105.name: Twilight Step
VEN-105.rulesText:
Move a unit with 3[M] or less.
[Flow] [4][P]

VEN-106.name: Wind and Ghosts
VEN-106.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose a unit at a battlefield. If it has 3[M] of less, banish it. Otherwise, return it to its owner's hand.
VEN-106.flavorText: The best strategy is to not have an enemy.

VEN-107.name: Decree of Discord
VEN-107.rulesText: Return any number of enemy Order units with total Might 5 or less to their owners' hands.
VEN-107.flavorText: Tradition is a prison. Break free.

VEN-108.name: Forgotten Relic
VEN-108.rulesText: When you play this or at the start of your Beginning Phase, [Burn 1]. When you burn a unit this way, do this: Give a friendly unit +[M] equal to the burned card's Might this turn.

VEN-109.name: Illaoi, Prophet of the Great Kraken
VEN-109.rulesText:
When you play me or when I score, play a 1[M] Tentacle unit token from Bilgewater.
I have +1[M] for each token unit you control.
VEN-109.flavorText: "We are not one soul. We are many."

VEN-110.name: Mel, Defiant Soul
VEN-110.rulesText:
[Empower] — Discard a spell
When I become [Empowered], banish an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3[M] or less.
VEN-110.flavorText: "Medardas are known for our strategy and strength."

VEN-111.name: Minah Swiftfoot
VEN-111.rulesText:
When I move to a battlefield, choose one —
• Each player discards 1.
• Each player draws 1.
VEN-111.flavorText: She's mastered ten styles of combat, but she's still working on a good catchphrase.

VEN-112.name: Zed, Without a Sound
VEN-112.rulesText:
When I conquer, play a 0[M] Shadow Clone unit token to your base.
[Action][>] [1][P]: Move me and a Shadow Clone you control to each other's locations.

VEN-113.name: Kennen, Storm of Shuriken
VEN-113.rulesText:
When you play me, [Burn 2].
When I conquer, give a spell in your trash [Flow] equal to its cost this turn.

VEN-114.name: Kharox
VEN-114.rulesText:
[Empower] [6][P][P]
When I become [Empowered], choose an opponent. They [Burn 3]. Then you may do this: Choose a unit in their trash and play it, ignoring its cost.

VEN-115.name: Ocean Drake
VEN-115.rulesText:
You may play me to an open battlefield.
When you play me, you may return a non-Dragon unit to its owner's hand.
VEN-115.flavorText: The pale glint of blue on blue is all the warning you'll get.

VEN-116.name: Dragon Form
VEN-116.rulesText:
Choose a unit. Its base Might becomes 5 this turn.
[Flow] [3]
VEN-116.flavorText: "The Dragon spirit is not magic. It is life, more anicent than ours." —Lee Sin

VEN-117.name: Disciple of Shen
VEN-117.rulesText:
[Hidden]
I have [Shield 3] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control.
VEN-117.flavorText: Even twilight itself takes on an apprentice or two.

VEN-118.name: Horns of the Dragon
VEN-118.flavorText: Don't mess with them. You know what you'll get.

VEN-119.name: Keeper of Law
VEN-119.rulesText: I cost [2][Y] less if ypou control a battlefield with exactly two units there.
VEN-119.flavorText: Order will be preserved. Unity will be maintained.

VEN-120.name: Masa, Crashing Thunder
VEN-120.rulesText:
You may pay [Y] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, [Stun] an enemy unit at a battlefield.
VEN-120.flavorText: He's louder than he looks, which is saying quite a bit.

VEN-121.name: Reluctant Leader
VEN-121.rulesText: When you play another unit, give me +2[M] this turn.
VEN-121.flavorText: Sometimes there's no one else who will do the job.

VEN-123.name: Soulspinner
VEN-123.flavorText: There are worse fates than being eaten.

VEN-124.name: Escaped Grayback
VEN-124.rulesText:
[Empower] — Kill a friendly unit
[Empowered][>] I havve +2[M].
VEN-124.flavorText: "Strength comes from the will to be free."

VEN-125.name: Hungry Wolf
VEN-125.rulesText: [Y]: Ready me and give me +1[M] this turn. Use only if you've chosen an enemy unit this turn and only once each turn.

VEN-126.name: Ki Barrier
VEN-126.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a unit. Prevent the next 7 damage that would be dealt to it this turn.

VEN-127.name: Lacerate
VEN-127.rulesText:
Choose a unit. If it's [Empowered], disempower it. Then kill it if it has 3[M] or less.
[Flow] [4][Y][Y]

VEN-128.name: Noxian Emissary
VEN-128.rulesText:
[Empower] [1][Y]
[Empowered][>][Deathknell][>] Play two 1[M] Recruit unit tokens to your base.
VEN-128.flavorText: He speaks with the full might of Noxus behind him.

VEN-129.name: Sacred Protector
VEN-129.rulesText: I don't deal combat damage unless I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control.
VEN-129.flavorText: It is single-mindedly dedicated to its charge.

VEN-131.name: Decree of Unity
VEN-131.rulesText: Kill an enemy Chaos unit or gear.

VEN-132.name: Fallen Feline
VEN-132.rulesText:
When you play me, name a spell.
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't play spells with that name.

VEN-133.name: Glowstone
VEN-133.rulesText:
[Empower] [A][A]
Disempower this, [E]: Choose a player. They gain control of this and recall it.
At the end of your turn, kill this and deal 5 to all units you control.

VEN-134.name: Kayle, Justified
VEN-134.rulesText:
[Empower] [3]
I can be [Empowered] up to 3 times.
I have +2[M] for each time I'm [Empowered].
While I'm [Empowered] three times, I have [Deflect 3] and [Ganking].

VEN-135.name: Kennen, Keeper of Balance
VEN-135.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me or I attack, you may pay [2] to stun a unit.
While there's a stunned enemy unit here, I have +2[M].

VEN-136.name: Ambessa, Respected and Feared
VEN-136.rulesText:
[Empower] [1][Y][Y]
[Empowered][>] I have [Assault 2].
[Empowered][>] When I attack, kill an enemy unit here with less Might than me.

VEN-137.name: Shady Spectacles
VEN-137.rulesText:
[Equip] [1][Y]
As this is attached to a unit, choose another friendly unit. The equipped unit becomes a copy of that unit for as long as this is attached to it.

VEN-138.name: Shen, Leader of the Kinkou Order
VEN-138.rulesText:
[Shield]
When I hold, if there is exactly one other unit you control here, you score 1 point.

VEN-139.name: Akali, Rogue Assassin
VEN-139.rulesText:
[Empower] [3][A]
[Action][>] [E]: If it's your turn, move a friendly unit in a showdown to base and if I'm [Empowered] ready it.
